name: SQUEEZE Inc.
summary: SQUEEZE, Inc. operates hotels of its own and also develops systems, plans and develops lodging facilities, and provides DX consulting. Its offerings include raising the value of real estate, solutions for running hotels, and planning for urban development and DX. Shinichi Tatebayashi and Sho Nakagawa founded it in 2014, and it has its headquarters in Kitahiroshima-shi, Japan.
